title: EFFORT BATCH 29 (R1 load shape + R3): a forced failure of the host's OWN save load (main-thread continuation of HostLoadSession) reaches StartFailed - the lobby is handed back, the client in the lobby was never served its save - and the next Start loads both machines
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1). Build with EFFORT BATCH 29 deployed (startfail lever reaches the host load; clientInLobby readout). The client joins the lobby BEFORE the failed load. NOTHING is saved.
oracles_absent: a start is already in flight on this machine

steps.expect_result: ^OK the next start continuation \(new game or host load\) throws once

expect_log.regex: \[Server\] HostLoadSession error - lobby restored, Start can be pressed again: System.InvalidOperationException: DEV startfail lever: forced host-load failure

steps.note: FIRST press: the host's own load throws once on the main thread (R3: this used to be logged as 'Host load' only - lobby wedged)
a wrongly served save would have landed by now
THE R3 CHECK: the host's lobby is usable again
THE R1 CHECK (load shape): the client was not served before the host's own load
the client was served after the host's load and settled
